results.title: Hushar Pittalu
results.overview: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

results.title: Rubberhead: The Life & Monsters of Steve Johnson
results.original_title: Rubberhead: The Life & Monsters of Steve Johnson
results.overview: Known for his intense work ethic, perfectionism, and obsession with breaking new ground, Steve Johnson has created iconic creatures and effects for some of the most beloved genre films in cinema history, working with everyone from John Carpenter, David Cronenberg, and Sam Raimi to James Cameron, Steven Spielberg, and Guillermo del Toro. His drive and ambition also led to heartbreaking acts of self-sabotage, divorce, and a serious drug addiction.

results.title: Cezanne on Art
results.overview: Inspired by conversations between Cezanne and his writer friend Joachim Gasquet, the film blends art, philosophy and landscape to approach the figure of the artist through the senses.

results.title: Wicked of Oz
results.overview: A freak tornado pulls Dorothy Gale into the wicked world of Oz just in time for the down-on-her-luck Kansas farm girl to confront Glinda, a starving cannibal who finds herself all out of Munchkin meat. Things go downhill from there, as Dorothy goes head-to-head (literally) against a skull-cracking Scarecrow, a Tin Man whose hobby is to collect still-beating hearts and a Cowardly Lion who pleases his master by ripping apart anyone he sees. Oz becomes Ooze as Dorothy – armed with scavenged weapons – battles her way through hordes of psychotic enemies until she finally happens upon her ultimate nemesis, the Wicked of Oz.

results.title: Barbecue
results.overview: Sebastiano, Pietro, and Giuseppe are young MMA fanatics who decide to set up a fight club in their backyard to stave off summer boredom. However, a bored policeman stands in their way, targeting the group and keeping a close eye on their every move. Sebastiano, the mastermind of the trio, wants to do things right, but the situation spirals out of control, ultimately leading to a tragic event.

results.title: Paper Roses
results.overview: A blind date gone wrong. Or gone right? In Paper Roses, two individuals are set up on a blind date. Unknowing of what has yet to come, they hit things off quite well.

results.title: Calling All Villains
results.overview: With the permanent cancellation of PUZZLEVISION, a former streaming service and media company, Mr. Puzzles is left choosing what to do next with his life after leaving his fame-seeking ambitions behind for good. Suddenly, he receives an invitation to a tournament for dastardly evil-doers that offers him a second chance—and promises to give him the perfect chance at redemption.

results.title: Perfect Strangers
results.overview: Martin and Albert have been in a steady but rocky relationship for 16 years, which is thrown off balance by the appearance of a mysterious stranger - with devastating consequences for everyone involved.

results.title: 300 Oaks
results.overview: It took 300 oaks to build the first farmhouses. When the trees ran out, wood gave way to stone, showing that identity transforms to stay. In the Arantzazu crypt, 23 chefs from Mahaia Kolektiboa meet artists in an immersive experience to address a crucial question: how to sustain an own identity today.

results.title: Kankaan De Ohle
results.overview: A widowed woman married to an old man - sparking an emotional journey that challenges society's norms and redefines humanity, compassion, and connection. Will this unusual bond change their lives forever?

results.title: Death Chart
results.overview: Things get weird when a sad girl astrologer obsessed with celebrity deaths makes a prediction.

results.title: Arjunan Per Paththu
results.overview: Arjunan, who witnessed his parents being killed by lightning in front of his eyes, cannot bear the shock and arrives in Chennai from his hometown Madurai. Arjunan, who joined a kayalang shop in Chennai, starts to love a woman. Before marrying that woman, he was a worker and wanted to become an entrepreneur. He gave away all the money he had saved up until then and bought an old Tata Ace and married the woman he loved. Arjuna happily starts driving the vehicle, thinking that his life has become as happy as he thought it would be. Arjuna, who has been facing constant problems with that old vehicle, realizes that he has been completely cheated in buying the vehicle. He brings together all those who have been affected like him and exposes all the frauds in buying and selling old vehicles, seeking justice for himself and all those who have been cheated like him.

results.title: Una pistola, una bala y un oso panda
results.original_title: Una pistola, una bala y un oso panda

results.title: Offseason
results.overview: On the night of her birthday party, stranded between a distant  boyfriend and a friend in love with her, Aliz unravels amid tension  and lies until she realizes: the only way out is to choose herself.

results.title: Sapling
results.overview: A grieving mother returns to the cursed woodland where her son vanished, forcing her abusive husband to face the monstrous consequence of the violence he left behind.

results.title: Motherf*ckers
results.overview: When Martín learns that his mother is going to marry Juan, the bully who tormented him as a child, he does what any son would do: sabotage the wedding... by sleeping with Juan's mother.

results.title: Before Me
results.overview: A heartbroken photographer falls for an aspiring writer, but after discovering her secret past his retroactive jealousy threatens to ruin everything.
